short_description: Full-day Miami to Key West trip with a 3-hour snorkel boat tour, basic snorkel gear, drinks after snorkeling and free time to explore Key West.
cancellation_summary: Cancel for free up to 24 hours before
location_address: 700 Collins Avenue Miami Beach, FL US 33139
description: Leave the driving to the professionals and enjoy a full-day Miami to Key West adventure that highlights coastal vistas and the iconic Seven Mile Bridge along the Overseas Highway. After a scenic ride south toward the Caribbean, spend the afternoon in vibrant Key West with time to wander Mallory Square, snap a photo at the Southernmost Point buoy, or savor authentic Key lime pie. The experience combines sightseeing, snorkeling, and independent exploration for a sun-drenched tropical escape.

what_is_included_items.value: Three-hour boat tour from Key West with a snorkel stop at the reef
Margaritas, wine and sodas provided after snorkeling
Approximately two hours of free time to explore Key West

itinerary:
1. Ca. 6.30AM bus departure from select Miami meeting points
2. Ca. 11.30AM arrival in Key West
3. Ca. 3 hours snorkel tour by boat
4. Ca. 2 hours free time to explore Key West on your own
5. Ca. 5.30PM bus departure back to Miami
6. Ca. 9.00 PM arrival in Miami depending on traffic
highlights:
* Visit Key West from Miami in one day
* Spot marine life in their natural habitat
* Snorkel the turquoise waters of the Florida Keys with basic snorkel gear included
* Soak in the sun on the boat deck or enjoy a swim in the warm ocean
* Enjoy free time to explore Key West
